attchmntText: Maha Rashtra Apex Corporation Limited has submitted to the Exchange, the financial results for the period ended September 30, 2026.
voiceSummary: Maha Rashtra Apex Corporation Limited approved its Unaudited Financial Results for the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026, during a Board Meeting held on November 12, 2026. The meeting commenced at 12.00 noon and concluded at 3.45 pm. The Board adopted the Standalone and Consolidated financial results, which were reviewed by the Audit Committee. A Limited Review Report from Statutory Auditors has been submitted to the stock exchanges. The financial statements are prepared in accordance with Indian Accounting Standards. Previous period figures have been regrouped to conform to current classification. The company operates in a single segment.
